models_evaluated: two-stage ViT and Swin Transformer model

links.outcome: Diagnostic AUC in internal versus external test hospital, generalizability across sites
links.effect: Slice-level AUC 0.98 internal vs 0.97 external; sensitivity 98.91% vs 99.61%; Dice 72.64% vs 69.11%; patient-level AUC 0.98 and 0.97.
links.quote: At the patient level, diagnostic performance remained high, with AUCs of 0.98 and 0.97 in the internal and external test sets, respectively.

links.outcome: Model diagnostic and segmentation performance compared against three orthopaedic surgeons
links.effect: Model outperformed surgeons in diagnosis and matched a 10-year-experienced attending in segmentation.
links.quote: It outperformed surgeons in diagnosis and matched a 10-year-experienced attending in segmentation.

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a deep learning model for CT diagnosis and segmentation of osteonecrosis of the femoral head across multicenter retrospective cohorts, including a reader comparison with orthopaedic surgeons.
